landmarks.name: Filling station
landmarks.cue: Yellow canopy on your right. Keep going straight.

landmarks.name: Water tank on stilts
landmarks.cue: Tall water tank behind a fence, on your left.

landmarks.name: Umbrella stalls
landmarks.cue: Row of umbrellas on your right. Slow down here.

landmarks.name: St Paul’s Anglican Church
landmarks.cue: White walls, blue roof, on your left. The main gate is 150 m further on, same side.

landmarks.name: Market gate
landmarks.cue: Green gate with a painted arch, on your left.

cards.title: Find the market when you get there.
cards.body: Many markets have no sign at the roadside. Marketdey shows up to five landmarks in the order you pass them on the way in.

cards.title: Get in, load up, get out.
cards.body: Know the turn before you reach it, so you are not circling with an empty van while the good stock goes.

cards.who: First-timers and people new to the city
cards.title: No street names needed.
cards.body: Follow the cues people actually use, like “yellow canopy on your right”, instead of addresses nobody knows.

cards.title: Stop calling for directions.
cards.body: Landmarks come up in the order you pass them. Check once at a glance and keep riding.

cards.title: Slow down at the right place.
cards.body: Each cue says which side and how far, so you are not braking at every junction looking for the gate.

cards.title: Roads change. You’ll still find it.
cards.body: Landmarks are added and confirmed by people who pass that way, so they stay current while you are away.

cards.title: Now see it from the road.
cards.body: Keep scrolling to ride in and watch each landmark come up as you pass it.
